query:
-- 所有 SOGO JOYCE 訂單中含 UP920A-VC 的記錄（包括已完成和未完成）
SELECT 
  o.orderNumber,
  o.customerName,
  o.status,
  o.deliveryDate,
  o.shopName,
  op.quantity,
  op.sku,
  op.productName
FROM orderProducts op
JOIN orders o ON op.orderId = o.id
WHERE (o.shopName = 'SOGO JOYCE' OR o.shopName LIKE '%sogo ktk%' OR o.shopName LIKE '%SOGO CWB JOYCE%')
  AND op.sku = 'UP920A-VC'
ORDER BY o.deliveryDate;
